mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC decline is decelerating week-on-week (t-3w: -86.3 → t-0w: -81.1), signaling stabilization of avoidance behavior. This flattening trajectory predicts continued modest recovery over the next four weeks as the rate of decline approaches zero.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC declined 5.2 percentage points over four weeks, indicating deceleration
regime_hint: steady state lockdown with stabilizing behavior
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days shows acceleration of decline (week-on-week drops exceed 2 percentage points) or remains flat within 1 percentage point of t-0w mean.

regime_hint: imminent reopening with transit policy shift expected
